description: Read any page of status403 as markdown: "/" for the homepage (services, process, booking, FAQ), "/blog" for the post index, or "/blog/<slug>" for a post in full. This is the same document the site serves to clients that ask for it with `Accept: text/markdown`.

path.description: Site path, such as "/" or "/blog/<slug>". A full status403.com URL works too.

name: read_page
title: Read a page as markdown
